note: Shipped defaults. explainer_qa returns fixes only, never these thresholds. Frame probing is not implemented; the caller supplies measurements. Learned corrections can tighten a bound and cannot loosen it.

rules.label: camera speed
rules.fix: Slow the camera so a phone viewer can follow it.

rules.label: how long a frame stays still
rules.fix: A frame holds still too long. Move the element the current word names.

rules.label: color strength
rules.fix: Color is outside the approved range. Move it toward the saved look, away from flat gray.

rules.label: loudness
rules.fix: Voice loudness is outside the delivery range.

rules.label: flicker
rules.fix: Flicker is too strong. Hold exposure and colors steady across frames.

rules.label: mobile readability
rules.fix: Type or the subject is not readable on a phone.
